p.src: 1  The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.

ja: が吹き荒れるように、それは
en: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.
u.src: 1  The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.

p.src: 2  A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

ja: れ。攻めよ。わたしはメディアのすべての
en: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.
u.src: 2  A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

p.src: 3  Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.

ja: くこともできず、うろたえて
en: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.
u.src: 3  Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.

p.src: 4  My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

ja: 怖が私を襲った。私が待ち望んだ
暮れは、私にとっておののきに変わった。
en: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
u.src: 4  My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

p.src: 5  They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!

en: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!
u.src: 5  They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!

p.src: 6  For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.

en: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.
u.src: 6  For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.

p.src: 7  When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”

ja: の一隊、ろばの一隊、らくだの一隊を
en: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”
u.src: 7  When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”

p.src: 8  He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.

en: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.
u.src: 8  He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.

p.src: 9  Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.

ja: えた。「倒れた。バビロンは
en: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.
u.src: 9  Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.

p.src: 10  You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

ja: いたことを、私はあなたがたに
en: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.
u.src: 10  You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

p.src: 11  The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

ja: 告。 セイルから私に
はどうなっているのか。
はどうなっているのか。」
en: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”
u.src: 11  The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

p.src: 12  The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”

en: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”
u.src: 12  The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”

p.src: 13  The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.

ja: よ、あなたがたはアラビアの茂みで
en: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.
u.src: 13  The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.

p.src: 14  They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

en: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.
u.src: 14  They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

p.src: 15  For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

en: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.
u.src: 15  For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

p.src: 16  For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

ja: 以内に、ケダルのすべての
en: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,
u.src: 16  For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

p.src: 17  and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”

ja: はわずかになる。主、イスラエルの
en: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”
u.src: 17  and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”
